summary: Online-grounded rationale for making local-only snapshot verification independent of huggingface_hub while keeping download/materialization mode dependent on the Hub client.

facts.fact: Offline Transformers use requires downloaded/cached files ahead of time, then HF_HUB_OFFLINE or local_files_only prevents online calls during loading.
snapshot_download downloads a repository snapshot at a selected revision and supports allow_patterns/ignore_patterns.
The TinyLlama tree publishes concrete required files and sizes, including a 608-byte config.json and 2.2 GB model.safetensors.
